aura.source: GOB 42 calls ApplyAuraEffect with child 695. Child 695 has a three-metre radius and two five-second +64 accuracy modifiers.
aura.runtime: AbilityAuras schedules each caster independently. AbilitySupport applies the same linked child to eligible friendly team players; AbilityBuffs replaces an existing copy before publishing the new pair.
aura.test: StarterTeamPatcherBuffsMode checks initial application, cross-caster replacement, a helper-only pulse and final expiry. Stock .2 PacketLog 8f7023603b50 shows CSR CSEQ 70/75 toggles, QAFriend applying the overlapping effect at 19:53:05, refreshing after CSR stops at 19:53:10 and final removals at 19:53:15. No stat stacks. The initial Team Patcher recipient proof is in PR586. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586

behavior-tests.source: GOB 42 is an 8 IS activation, runs ApplyAuraEffect and ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation on its five-second update and adds a 15-second reuse timer at termination.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler handles activation cost; AbilityAuras runs the aura until toggled off, depleted or the source leaves the world; AbilityCooldowns emits the off-time reuse. The last recipient effect has its own lifetime.
behavior-tests.test: CombatAuraPulsesShippedAccuracyAndChargesTwelveInnerStrength checks both accuracy totals, the 12 IS recurring debit, insufficient IS shutdown and the 15 s cooldown. StarterTeamPatcherBuffsMode checks exact stock casts, team boundaries and two-caster overlap. The stock .2 session 8f7023603b50 confirms the 15 s 80 bd 01 timer and expiry. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586
